d: Responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies specifically for the assigned segments. He/ She works closely with the marketing team to create customized campaigns that address the unique needs and preferences of the segments. The Segments Principal also uses data analysis tools to monitor the performance of marketing campaigns and adjust strategies to increase market share, grow revenue and increase customer engagement.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred.
At least 7 years of experience in the service industry, preferably with a strong background in banking.
Exposure to investment products and financial services is preferred
r: Develop a process to gather and communicate appropriate competitive intelligence to drive strategy development based on marketplace dynamics
Develop marketing plans to reach targeted customer segments, utilizing different communication channels such as emails, social media channels, direct mail and advertisements
Collaborate with Product Managers in developing products and services that meet the specific needs of targeted customer segments

Collaborate with the Sales team to identify target and leverage an in-depth understanding of customer needs within the segment to address the unique the preferences of customers through market research and competitive analysis ensuring effective sales to targeted customer segments
Develop and implement customer retention strategies to ensure customer loyalty is maintained
Manage and maintain the segment specific dashboards and performance metrics to measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and strategies and making adjustments, if necessary
Play critical role in generating and reporting identified KPIs in terms of financials, sales and portfolio management
Maintain the quality of the portfolio and acquisitions.
